company.name: QRNSYS
company.shortDescription: QRNSYS is an IT company that combines blockchain and AI to provide digital solutions for the insurance, investment, and banking sectors.
company.description:
QRNSYS is a Web3 Technology provider combining Blockchain and AI to deliver innovative solutions that fit the needs of three industries (Insurance, Investment, and Banking) together. Our competitive advantage lies in our ability to combine Blockchain and AI-powered technologies with a deep understanding of the pitfalls of the finance industry, which enables us to deliver transparent, efficient, and customer-centric insurance products. 
Our mission is to reshape the future of the finance industry with a revolutionary solution powered by the robust Self-Sovereign Identity (SSID) and account-based Blockchain.
